notes.title: Demo Patch 2
notes.content:
UPDATE 2: The CYBER-ASSASSIN Demo has been patched again! Here are some of the fixes + updates thus far:


Patches:
Bloody cloak glitch fixed
New blood textures
Bloody footprints after killing enemies
New Upgrade Menu background
New Ability meters designs
New Staff of Fury effects + updated damage
Enemy shields are tougher, Double Cut Slash combo will still do extra damage to shields
Ammo packs were removed in the first few encounters before acquiring the pistols
Larger Grenade damage range
More XP boxes throughout the levels
XP and Health boxes have button prompt pop ups
Blue meter underneath the Health Bar is now an Armor Bar

More patches and updates coming soon! Thank you all so much for the ongoing support and feedback! I couldn't have done any of this without you all, you guys are awesome!

notes.title: Brutal Demo PATCH Update
notes.content:
UPDATE: The CYBER-ASSASSIN Demo has been patched. Here are some of the fixes thus far:


The How to play menu overlay has been fixed. No more overlapping menus.
Sentinel Execution w only using sword in animation now
Spawning in checkpoints is fixed. There shouldn't be any more spawning underneath the map.
More tightened Target Lock
Improved combat inputs for smoother and faster combat experience
EMP Grenade replaced with a Normal Grenade. EMP will be an unlockable explosive in the future.
Updated screenshots in the Sneak Peek gallery, screenshots from 2024 wrap up video.

I’m aware of some of the other bugs and fixes that need to be made such as the jump animation and the save settings. I will be fixing those in future patches as well! ^^

I would also like to mention that the rest of the game is still being worked on and in development. I am only patching up the demo so I can be sure players can have the best experience possible! Thank you for the feedback and support! You guys are awesome as always!

notes.title: Cyber-Assassin Demo BRUTAL UPDATE Available now!!!
notes.content:
Cyber-Assassin Demo: BRUTAL UPDATE has just been released!!! This update is packed with new content, such as the previously mentioned brutal kills, stealth gameplay, boss fights, assault rifle, combat scoring, and much more! But now also includes even more new features such as a checkpoint system, a new EMP Stun Grenade, and more!
There is a lot packed into this demo! I want to thank you all so much for your patience and ongoing support, it really means a lot to me! I hope you guys enjoy the new demo update! And of course feedback is always appreciated! Enjoy!

notes.title: Brutal Update release delayed to October 20th
notes.content: Hey everyone! Unfortunately due to several bugging issues with the demo and some incompletions the Brutal Update will have to be released on October 20th! I want to deliver the best version of the demo I can and want to make it as polished as possible! Thank you for understanding and I appreciate all the support!

notes.title: Cyber-Assassin Demo: BRUTAL UPDATE - Coming October 13th!!!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! This announcement here on Steam is a bit late but I'm happy to announce that the Brutal Update will be dropping this October! its been a long time coming, and I cant wait for you all to try it out and see what it has to offer! Stay tuned for more updates and I hope you are all doing well! Stay awesome!

notes.content:

Thank you everyone for the ongoing support! It means a lot to me and you guys really help make this project possible. 

- Isaac Trujillo
